component.name: Linux Hardware Monitor
component.summary: Sensors, performance graphs and a task manager

description.p: A native Qt system monitor for Linux. It shows temperatures, fans, loads and clocks of the CPU, memory, disks, network adapters, graphics cards and the battery, next to a process manager, systemd services and startup applications.
It runs without root rights and shows only what the system exposes: a value that cannot be read is displayed as N/A, never invented.

ul.li: Task-manager style performance pages for every device
Sensor history with statistics, search, favourites and CSV export
Disk health from SMART, thermal throttling and stopped-fan warnings
Simulation mode to try other hardware
Choose which reading is the CPU temperature: the package sensor, the hottest core or the average of the cores
Theme setting that can follow the desktop
Overheat notifications are grouped per device
About page with the author, the build and the system details
